title: sec filing / accounting / auditor change | Unknown | Douglas Elliman Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Douglas Elliman Inc. (real estate brokerage firm) filed Form 8-K disclosing dismissal of Deloitte & Touche LLP as its independent auditor and appointment of EisnerAmper LLP as replacement, effective April 6, 2026. The change was approved by the Board on Audit Committee recommendation. No disagreements or reportable events with the former auditor were disclosed.
